title: Bump Java target version from 17 to 21
description:
The project targets Java 17 (`<java.version>17</java.version>` in root pom.xml, CI pins Java 17 in .github/workflows/lint.yml). This blocks upgrading JavaFX past 11.0.2 — JavaFX 25.0.2 requires Java 23 (class version 67.0), and even JavaFX 21+ needs Java 21.

Bumping to Java 21 (the current LTS) would:
- Allow JavaFX upgrades (up to 21.x at least)
- Enable modern language features (virtual threads, pattern matching, record patterns, etc.)

Changes needed:
1. Update `<java.version>17</java.version>` to `21` in root pom.xml
2. Update `java-version: '17'` to `'21'` in .github/workflows/lint.yml (both java and golden jobs)
3. Verify all dependencies are compatible with Java 21
4. Once on 21, JavaFX can be bumped to 21.x (but not 25.x which needs Java 23)
